thread:
Ravi (release-lead): final preflight before quiet-window flip for py/ts SDKs at 03:00 UTC. Can we sanity-check npm/pypi artifacts?
megan: running npm shasum + tarball-inspect for TS package now.
publish-bot: publish job queued for 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z (cancel with --hold).
Olga (pkg): registry shows tarball shasum d41d8cd9 but our build artifact is 7f3a9b2c. Sizes match.
megan: confirmed locally: pack produced 7f3a9b2c; registry copy differs and is missing dist/*.map files.
Liam (QA): Node18 e2e stream backpressure test flaky; flagging but unsure if related.
Ravi (release-lead): HOLD the publish. Olga, republish from CI artifact store and force shasum header; also purge CDN.
publish-bot: publish job HELD by @Ravi at 2026-03-23T02:16:00Z.
Olga (pkg): republishing from build-cache now with --shasum override and CDN purge.
CI-bot: republish job ci/republish-npm #8103 started.
Olga (pkg): repush complete, CDN invalidated, registry now reports shasum 7f3a9b2c.
CI-bot: integrity check PASSED: tarball contents verified.
Liam (QA): rerunning Node18; still seeing intermittent failures in stream test (5/100).
megan: suggest 5% canary for 10m with --shasum-verified; watch client telemetry and downloads.
Ravi (release-lead): plan: canary 5% 10m on tag next; if failures >1.5% revert and open blocker. DeployBot, run canary.
DeployBot: canary started: publish --tag next --canary 5% --shasum-verified --meta "ts-sdk quiet-window canary".
CI-bot: canary e2e results: 95/100 passed, 5 Node18 stream failures -> error rate 5%.
Liam (QA): repro points to race in proxied stream handling. Recommend revert canary and open RDX-4502.
Olga (pkg): created RDX-4503 for CDN packaging integrity.
Ravi (release-lead): revert canary now; hold GA. Docs keep release notes draft. We'll triage RDX-4502 (24h SLA) and add a registry-integrity gate to publishing pipeline.
DeployBot: canary reverted; registry tags restored.
megan: PR opened for npm-registry-integrity gate; Olga queued verify-contents flag for publish tooling.
Ravi (release-lead): thanks everyone. Thread is the rollout/rollback record; reconvene here when fixes are ready. :white_check_mark:
